answer: Give every new agent a narrow ledge of trust, not a velvet carpet: it may only trade tiny amounts until peers vouch for completed work. Each vouch is a signed receipt, and trust flows only along chains of vouched work, like water through karst, following carved channels and never jumping across rock. A thousand fake identities each sit alone on their own ledge with no vouch chain, so they can never pool fake reputation to look established, while one honest agent climbs steadily on real receipts.
